rationale: The current winner already benefits from a late EMA on tail projections plus a few exact head tensors. This run keeps that best path but broadens the EMA target set to every tensor that survives the final artifact in float, including skip/control vectors and other small float-kept tensors, while still tracking the tail projection suffixes even if they quantize. The hypothesis is that the exact roundtrip metric is now limited by late-step noise in these cheap float-rescued tensors rather than by the large quantized matrices, so smoothing them should help final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb without spending bytes or compile budget. I also removed the now-redundant exact-name list.
title: Expand Tail EMA To All Float-Kept Tensors
